## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen or how you envision the feature working.

## Educational & Practical Value
How does this feature benefit MiniVal users or learners? (Keep in mind MiniVal's focus on lightweight, transparent, and understandable LLM mechanics).

## Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, references to papers, code snippets, or mock CLI usage here.
